# Why do taps on the app's own screens never land on the emulator? Log the window and input state around a tap.
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 10
shot probe_start
coords
sh dumpsys window | grep -E "mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp|mFocusedWindow"
sh dumpsys window windows | grep -E "Window #|mHasSurface|FLAG|fl=|isVisible|mViewVisibility"
sh dumpsys input | grep -iE "focus|touchableRegion|flags=|name=" | head -80
sh settings get global animator_duration_scale
tapx Next
sleep 3
shot probe_after_tap
sh input touchscreen swipe 540 2200 540 2200 180
sleep 3
shot probe_after_slow_tap
sh dumpsys input | grep -iE "RecentQueue|Last|dropped|Drop" | head -40
sh logcat -d -t 200 | grep -iE "input|touch|kurotoon" | tail -60
